<js>
 loadDocType="{{@@body@data-doctype}}";
 loadType="{{@@body@data-randomtype}}";
sid=baseUrl.match(/(\d+).html/)[1];
url=baseUrl.replace(/\d+.html/,'')

var section = {
    loadDocType: loadDocType,
    loadType: loadType,
    sid:sid,
    content: {
        childNode: [],
        
        init: function(c){
            this.body=c
            if (section.loadType == 'normal') {
      this.load(String(java.base64Decode(java.getString('//*[@name="client"]/@content'))))
            } else if (section.loadType == 'substep') {
                var d = 'r' + section.sid;
                var f = false;
                if (section.loadDocType == 'xml') {
                    d += '.xml'
                } else if (section.loadDocType == 'json') {
                    d += '.json';
                    f = true
                } else {
                    return false
                };        
             cookie="PHPSESSID="+java.get(baseUrl,{}).cookie("PHPSESSID");
            token= java.get(url+d,{"X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest","referer":baseUrl,"cookie":String(cookie)}).header("token")                
                	this.load(token)      	
            } else {
                return false
            };               
        },
        load: function(a) {         
            a = String(java.base64Decode(a)).split(/[A-Z]+%/);      
            var b = 0,
            start = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < this.body.length; i++) {
                if (String(this.body[i]).match(/h2/i)) {
                    start = i + 1
                };
                if (String(this.body[i]).match(/div/i)&& this.body[i].attr("class") != 'chapter') {
                    break
                }
            };
          
            for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                if (a[i] < 5) {
                    this.childNode[a[i]] = this.body[i + start];
                      b++
                } else {
                    this.childNode[a[i] - b] = this.body[i + start]                 
                }
            };
  }
}
}
section.content.init(java.getElement("@@id.content@children!0").toArray());
section.content.childNode.join("")
</js>

ruleContent.content:
if(String(java.getString('.manga-picture@source@srcset',src)).match(/\/h2\/avif\//)){ //.avif结尾 result=java.getString('id.pages@tag.a.-2@text') let content = "" let yy = "https://file.acgnngca.com/h2/avif/"+src.match(/(\d+\/\d+\_)/)[1] for(i=0;i<=Number(result);i++){ content+="" } }else if (baseUrl.match(/\/hanime\//)){ //视频 let name= java.getString('h2@text',src) let intro= java.getString('.animation-description@p@text',src) let kond= java.getString('.info@span@text',src) let kind= java.getString('.manga-tags@a@text',src) pi=src.match(/contentUrl\"\:\s\"(.*?)\"\,/) pi = pi?pi[1] : 1; p=String(java.webView(pi,"baseUrl","")).replace(/.*body\>(.*?)\<\/body.*/,'$1') if (book['durChapterIndex'] == chapter['index']) { b64 = java['base64Encode'](`

${name}

${intro}

${kond}

${kind}

`); dataUrl = 'data:text/html;base64,' + b64; java['startBrowser'](dataUrl, title); java['toast']('正在加载视频\n视频加载较慢，请耐心等待'); } '【刷新正文】播放\n✅直链:\n' + p; }else if(baseUrl.match(/.*cos\//)){ result=result.replace(/\\/g,'').replace(/.*src\=\"(.*?)\"\s\/\>\"\,\"pager.*/g,'$1') if(!baseUrl.match(/\-/)){ java.toast('\n'+'🧾文章较长，请稍候🧾') } let headers = JSON.stringify({"headers":{"Referer":"https://www.acgmhb.com/"}}); result.split('\n').map(x=>``).join('\n'); }else if(baseUrl.match(/\/western\//)){ p=java.getString('id.pages@tag.a.-2@text') i=baseUrl.match(/\-(\d+)\.html/) i=i?i[1]:1 java.toast('\n'+'❗当前文章无规律，加载较慢❗'+'加载' + p + '页正文'+'，本章加载进度:' + i + '/' + p); result=java.getString('.manga-picture@img@html') } else if(baseUrl.match(/\/asmr\//)){ p=result.match(/url\:\s\'(.*?)\'\,/) p=p?p[1]:1 }else if(String(java.getString('.manga-picture@img@src')).match(/\/\d+\_\d\_\d+\.webp/)){ result=java.getString('id.pages@tag.a.-2@text') k=String(java.getString('.manga-picture@img@src',src)).replace(/\d+\_\d\_\d+\.webp/,'') //java.log(k) let content = "" for(i=1;i<=Number(result);i++){ content += ``; } }else { result=java.getString('id.pages@tag.a.-2@text') k=String(java.getString('.manga-picture@img@src',src)).replace(/(\d{3}\.webp|\d{3}\.jpg)/,'') java.log(k) k2=String(java.getString('.manga-picture@img@src',src)).replace(/.*(\..*)$/,'$1') let content = "" for(i=1;i<=Number(result);i++){ content+="" } }
ruleContent.nextContentUrl:
<js>
if(baseUrl.match(/\_cos\//)){
p=baseUrl.match(/(\d+)-*\d*.html/)
p=p?p[1]:1
java.log(p)
pi=result.match(/\.\..*\"\>(\d+)\<\\/)
pi=pi?pi[1]:1
pageSum=parseInt(pi)
result=Array.from({length:pageSum-1},
(_,i)=>`https://www.acgmhb.com/ajax_cos/${p}-${i+2}.html?ajax=1`)
}else if(baseUrl.match(/western/)){
java.getString('text.下一页@href')
}else{null}
</js>

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
if (baseUrl.match(/webtoon/)){
	java.getElements('ul@.webtoon')
	}else if (baseUrl.match(/hanime/)){
	java.getElements('#list@.grid-item')
	}else if (baseUrl.match(/western/)){
	java.getElements('#western_album@li')
	}else if (baseUrl.match(/asmr/)){
	java.getElements('#asmr_file_list@li')
	}else if (baseUrl.match(/special/)){
	java.getElements('dl@dd@a')
}else{
		java.getElements('#list@li')
}
</js>

if (p) {
  result = java.getString('source.1@srcset')
} else {
  result = java.getString('img@src');
}
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:

	book.type = 64;
java.getElements('body')
}else if(result.match(/前后章节列表/)){
	book.type = 64;
	java.getElements('dl@dd@span@a')
	}else if (baseUrl.match(/\/h\//)){
	book.type = 64;
	java.getElements('body')
		}else if (baseUrl.match(/anime/)){
	book.type = 8;
	java.getElements('#list@li@a')
		}else if (baseUrl.match(/asmr/)){
	book.type = 32;
	java.getElements('body')
		}else if (baseUrl.match(/special/)){
	book.type = 8;
	java.getElements('#list@li@span@a')
		}else if (baseUrl.match(/hanime/)){
	book.type = 8;
	java.getElements('#playlist-scroll@.related-watch-wrap a[-1:0]')
			}else{
	book.type = 64;
	java.getElements('.categorys@dd@a')
	}
</js>

${name}

${intro}

${kond}

${kind}

book.author: 浅行
book.intro: 1994年是个特殊的年份，因为新中国最大的水电站，就在这年的12月份开工建设。 为了能让三（峡）江水电站，能在规定的时间内动工。 有这么一群默默在背后付出过努力和汗水的人，他们走乡串户，安排好每一村每一户，这是他们的工作，也是他们的责任。 而我们的主角刘学明，就是他们中的一员。 为了迎接改革开放，新时代的大变迁，为了祖国的繁荣昌盛，他们在背后默默地为祖国的发展和建设，付出着自己努力和汗水！
book.name: 三江之路

book.author: 玉帛
book.intro: 周影和周清一开始学舞狮只想着赚点零钱补贴家用，谁知道他们一不小心，就从一支山村醒狮队，一路披荆斩棘，乘风破浪，捧回了世界狮王争霸赛的冠军，吐气扬眉扬我国威，还成功将家乡的土特产带到海外，带领古龙村脱贫走上致富路！
book.name: 狮舞者
